status_note: Behavioral five-rule fixture (lease RULE-BEHAVIORAL-FIVE-0001, RULE_GAPS_2026-08-22.md section 2 M1-M5; reworked after independent review disproved the constructor-only nzm premise). RuleZextEliminate/RuleSignForm/RuleSignNearMult/RuleShiftBitops/RuleShift2Mult applyOp driven through ActionPool-equivalent dispatch (applyOp runs only when the op opcode is in getOpList, action.cc:748-750) on synthetic op chains in a real BfdArchitecture Funcdata. Each rule: >=2 positives (oracle performs the transform), >=1 guard negative, >=1 dispatch-refused negative pinning the opcode the old Rugra registration wrongly transformed. RuleShiftBitops additionally runs Funcdata::calcNZMask (funcdata_varnode.cc:856-927) over the assembled chains before applyOp on BOTH sides, so the written-input sparse-nzm positives observe the propagated masks the main pipeline reads (ActionNonzeroMask coreaction.cc:5507 precedes the rule pools). Scope: applyOp-level IR projection; pipeline convergence is covered by the curl E2E differential in the code commits, not this fixture.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: op/fd reference mutation per rule: ZextEliminate newConstant(smallsize,val)+copySymbolIfValid(vn2)+opSetInput(zextslot then otherslot) (ruleaction.cc:2517-2520); SignForm opSetInput(a,0)/opSetInput(newConstant(4,n),1)/opSetOpcode(SRIGHT) fixed order (cc:8469-8472); SignNearMult newOp(2,op->getAddr())+newUniqueOut(x->getSize())+opInsertBefore(newdiv,op), AND op becomes INT_MULT(divvn,pow) (cc:8579-8591); ShiftBitops AND/MULT->newConstant(vn->getSize(),0) at slot 0, ADD/XOR/OR->bitop->getIn(1-i) at slot 0 (cc:549-564); Shift2Mult opSetInput(const,1)+opSetOpcode(MULT) (cc:3747-3750).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: ZextEliminate tries slot 0 then swaps on a slot-1 zext (cc:2497-2508); SignNearMult scans ADD inputs i=0..1 for INT_RIGHT with constant amount, non-const amount continues to the other slot (cc:8551-8560); ShiftBitops scans bitop inputs i=0..numInput()-1 and breaks at the FIRST input whose shifted nzm & output mask == 0 (cc:539-548), i selects bitop->getIn(1-i) for ADD/XOR/OR; Shift2Mult checks op->getIn(0)->getDef() first, then walks the output's descendants in order until an ADD/SUB/MULT is found (cc:3732-3744); dispatch order is the case list order.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: SignNearMult n = RIGHT amount then n = size*8 - n, both must stay >0, pow = 1<<n (cc:8563-8566/8579); ShiftBitops sa = LEFT/RIGHT offset, SUBPIECE offset*8, INT_MULT leastsigbit_set (-1 rejects), leftshift flag per opcode (cc:501-522); ZextEliminate smallsize = zext->getIn(0)->getSize() and the val>>(8*smallsize)==0 zero-loss check (cc:2514-2516); no counters persist across applyOp calls; nzm lifecycle: constructor init + per-mainloop calcNZMask refinement (ActionNonzeroMask coreaction.cc:5507), never reset mid-rule.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: Dispatch key is exact opcode membership in getOpList (zexteliminate 11,12,15,16; signform 63; signnearmult 27; shiftbitops 29,30,63,32; shift2mult 29) matching action.cc:748-750 perop buckets; guard comparisons: loneDescend==op identity (cc:2513), mask==(calc_mask<<n)&calc_mask value equality (cc:8567-8569), sgnvn->getDef()->code()==INT_SRIGHT with sshiftop->getIn(0)==x pointer identity and amount==8*|x|-1 (cc:8570-8577), c>=a->getSize() for SignForm (cc:8465-8466), nzm swallow comparison vs calc_mask(op->getOut()->getSize()) for ShiftBitops (cc:539-546) where getNZMask (varnode.hh:231) returns the nzm field: constructor-initialized (varnode.cc:590-606, constants=offset, else ~0) and forward-refined by Funcdata::calcNZMask (funcdata_varnode.cc:856-927: DFS pop assignment via PcodeOp::getNZMaskLocal cc:874, non-written inputs cc:890-894, MULTIEQUAL worklist cc:920-921), which ActionNonzeroMask (coreaction.cc:5507) runs before the rule pools each mainloop.

analysis_options: none: direct RuleBehavior subclass table harness; no decompilation pipeline options

oplist_dispatch_contract.covers: getOpList opcode sets for all five rules (11,12,15,16 / 63 / 27 / 29,30,63,32 / 29) plus ActionPool-equivalent dispatch refusal on non-member opcodes.

zexteliminate_cases.covers: 3 positives (EQUAL slot0, NOTEQUAL slot1 swap, LESSEQUAL 2->4 resize) + guard negatives (val>>(8*smallsize)!=0, shared zext loneDescend, non-constant other input) + INT_ZEXT dispatch refusal replacing the old same-size zext->COPY fold.

signform_cases.covers: 2 positives (sub(sext(V:1->4),2)=>V s>>7, sub(sext(V:4->8),4)=>V s>>31) + guard negatives (offset<|V|, INT_ZEXT input) + INT_SRIGHT dispatch refusal replacing the old sext(V) s>> c pattern.

signnearmult_cases.covers: 2 positives (n=4 and n=8 with the shift side on either ADD slot; SDIV insert pinned via in0def=34/defin1 pow) + guard negatives (mask mismatch, sign shift 30!=31) + INT_MULT dispatch refusal replacing the old rewrite-existing-MULT algorithm.

shiftbitops_cases.covers: 5 constructor-nzm positives (AND+LEFT 20 -> #0, ADD+LEFT 20 -> V, OR+RIGHT 24 -> V, SUBPIECE byte offset, MULT leastsigbit_set) + guard negatives (no swallow, ADD under RIGHT) + shift-by-0 no-fold and INT_SRIGHT dispatch refusal replacing the old shift-by-0->COPY behavior + 3 calcNZMask-propagated cases: bitops_propagated_add_pos (the review counterexample (X + (W&0x80))<<7 -> X<<7, fires only under propagated nzm), bitops_propagated_subpiece_pos (written-input i=0 break -> #0), bitops_propagated_dense_neg (0xfe survives -> no change).

shift2mult_cases.covers: 3 positives (descendant ADD/SUB, input-side ADD) + guard negatives (COPY-only consumer, shift>=32) + INT_RIGHT dispatch refusal removing the old V>>c -> V*2^c semantic inversion.
